configurations.name: scaffald-local
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter scaffald-app web --clear

configurations.name: scaffald-remote
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; APP_ENV=dev dotenv -e .env.dev -- pnpm --filter scaffald-app web --clear --port 8082

configurations.name: ui-docs
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; cd packages/ui/docs-site && npx docusaurus start --port 3333

configurations.name: storybook
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; cd packages/ui && npx storybook dev -p 6006

configurations.name: sdk-docs
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; cd packages/sdk/docs-site && npx docusaurus start --port 3334
